label: Conspiracy that was TRUE

szenen.text: From 1932, U.S. health officials ran a study in *Alabama.*
It involved *600 Black men.* Most had syphilis.
They were told they had *'bad blood.'*
They were never told the truth, or *offered a cure.*
By the 1940s, *penicillin* was the standard treatment.
It still wasn't given. The study ran *40 years.*
Why did it take so long? *Follow* for more true files.

caption: The U.S. government once deceived hundreds of men in a 40-year study. Did you learn this in school? AI voice & edit. Footage: Pixabay/Pexels.
